# ex: pattern with import and package-qualified replacement
ex {
	import "fmt"
	var x int
	x + 1 -> fmt.Sprintf("%d", x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

import "fmt"

func F() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d", 1+1)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 import "fmt"

 func F() string {
-	return fmt.Sprintf("%d", 1+1)
+	return fmt.Sprintf("%d", fmt.Sprintf("%d", 1))
 }
